department: Department of Statistics and Data Science, The Wharton School

deadline.value: The Wharton Doctoral application for Fall 2027 closes December 15, 2026 (11:59 PM EST); all tests must be taken by then.
deadline.quote: The application for Fall 2027 will close on December 15th, 2026.

app_fee.value: Wharton Doctoral application fee is $80, nonrefundable.
app_fee.quote: A nonrefundable application fee of $80 must accompany your application.

fee_waiver.value: Only Military, Fulbright and SUMMIT applicants can waive the fee; there are no other exceptions.
fee_waiver.quote: Military, Fulbright, and SUMMIT applicants may waive the application fee.

also.quote: There are no other exceptions for offering application fee waivers.

gre_general.value: Statistics and Data Science applicants must submit GRE scores (GMAT is not accepted for this program); there is no minimum score.
gre_general.quote: Statistics and Data Science: GRE only

also.quote: While there is no minimum test score required to apply

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

english_waiver.value: TOEFL or IELTS is required for non-native speakers, but you can request a waiver if your degree was taught in English, documented by transcripts; no minimum score is stated.
english_waiver.quote: You may request an English Language Test Waiver if you have earned an undergraduate or master’s degree (or will receive the degree by June 2027) in an English-speaking country or from an institution in which English is the language of instruction.

funding.value: All admitted Wharton PhD students receive a full fellowship covering stipend, tuition and health insurance.
funding.quote: All students admitted to the Wharton Doctoral Programs receive a full fellowship that includes a stipend and covers the cost of tuition and health insurance.

entry_route.value: A degree equivalent to a four-year US bachelor's is enough, including a 3-year bachelor's; a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: International candidates must have a college-level education equivalent to a four-year United States baccalaureate degree.

also.quote: Many candidates from three-year programs have a master’s degree as well, but it is not required.

supervisor.value: The pages do not say whether a supervisor is needed before admission.

notes: Admitted through the Wharton Doctoral Programs (own application, fee and GRE rules), not the SAS Graduate Division. TOEFL/IELTS minimums are not stated; supervisor rule not stated.
